options.content:
Primary question: what is broken now, and where should the operator drill down first?
Scope: pipeline=$pipeline, run_type=$run_type, selected Grafana time range.
Reading guide: empty tables mean no recent signal in the selected window, not necessarily OK.

panels.title: System Status
panels.description: Current L0 operator state. Status values are OK (0), WARNING (1), CRITICAL (2 or 3), or UNKNOWN. CRITICAL means runtime, DQ, control-plane, workflow, or gold signals are failing for the selected pipeline/run_type. WARNING means non-fatal DQ or pending-gold conditions. Next action: follow the route shown in Next Action, then use the top-level dashboard bus.

panels.title: Next Action
panels.description: Action route projection for the selected pipeline/run_type. If the panel resolves to `NO_ROUTE`, validate that `bioetl_overview_pipeline_run_type_universe` exists for the selected pipeline/run_type combination. The row exposes `action_target`, `action_reason`, and `action_dashboard_uid`; Runtime > Control Plane > Gold Lifecycle > DQ > Provider > Workflow > Monitor. Provider route stays global in origin but is projected back onto the selected run_type scope for L0 consistency.

panels.title: L0 Inputs
panels.description: Current L0 inputs (Runtime, DQ, Gold, Control Plane, Provider, Workflow). Status values are OK (0), WARNING (1), CRITICAL (2 or 3), or UNKNOWN.

panels.title: Runtime Blockers
panels.description: Current runtime blocker summary only; no $__range evidence. Status values are OK (0), WARNING (1), CRITICAL (2 or 3), or UNKNOWN. Open Runtime from the top-level bus for exact blocker condition rows.

panels.title: DQ Status
panels.description: Current DQ summary for the selected pipeline/run_type scope. Status values are OK (0), WARNING (1), CRITICAL (2 or 3), or UNKNOWN.

panels.title: Gold Lifecycle
panels.description: Lifecycle-state projection for gold output. `lifecycle_state` distinguishes runtime-owned failure, missing gold after success, pending, disabled, and healthy recent gold. Status values are OK (0), WARNING (1), CRITICAL (2 or 3), or UNKNOWN. Disabled Gold stage returns OK and is a valid non-error state.

panels.title: Control Plane
panels.description: Current control-plane summary for manifest, ledger, checkpoint, and lineage guardrails. Status values are OK, WARNING, CRITICAL, or UNKNOWN. Open Control Plane from the top-level bus for the exact failing contract.

panels.title: Provider Global
panels.description: GLOBAL provider scope across pipelines. Status values are OK, WARNING, CRITICAL, or UNKNOWN. This panel intentionally ignores selected pipeline/run_type filters.

panels.title: Workflow Selected
panels.description: Selected pipeline/run_type workflow summary only. Status values are OK, WARNING, CRITICAL, or UNKNOWN.

panels.title: Workflow Global
panels.description: GLOBAL workflow scope across pipeline/run_type combinations. Status values are OK, WARNING, CRITICAL, or UNKNOWN.

panels.title: Runtime Blockers Trend
panels.description: 24-hour historical trend of runtime blocker status. Shows OK (0), WARNING (1), CRITICAL (2 or 3), or UNKNOWN. Click on Runtime dashboard for detailed blocker conditions.

panels.title: DQ Status Trend
panels.description: 24-hour historical trend of DQ status. Shows OK (0), WARNING (1), CRITICAL (2 or 3), or UNKNOWN. Click on Data Quality dashboard for detailed DQ conditions.

panels.title: Gold Lifecycle Trend
panels.description: 24-hour historical trend of gold lifecycle status. Shows OK (0), WARNING (1), CRITICAL (2 or 3), or UNKNOWN. Disabled Gold stage returns OK as a valid non-error state.

panels.title: Historical Failures (range evidence)
panels.description: Historical evidence only. Keeps `pipeline` and `run_type` labels from the active Grafana window.

panels.title: Recent terminal runs (range evidence)
panels.description: Historical terminal-run evidence only. Keeps `pipeline`, `run_type`, and `status` labels from the active Grafana window.

panels.title: Silver Rejects Count + Rate
panels.description: Selected-range Silver filter reject count and ratio against Bronze records. Evidence only; current DQ incident state lives in Data Quality.

options.content:
Raw metric starting points for this dashboard are
System Status: bioetl_l0_status{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"},
Next Action: bioetl_l0_next_action_route{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"},
Input Status: bioetl_l0_input_status{pipeline=~"chembl_assay",run_type=~"incremental"}.
Exact blocker reasons live in the Control Plane, Runtime, Data Quality, Provider Health, and Workflow dashboards.
Historical evidence stays in the row above.
